{{Top|leg}}
'''Radiation storms''',<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref> also known as '''radiation fields'''<ref name="SotG">''[[Starships of the Galaxy]]''</ref> and '''radiation belts''', were a natural phenomenon that occurred in [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. [[Starship/Legends|Starships]] used their [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor arrays]] to avoid radiation fields,<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> as they were known to vary in intensity and could damage or outright destroy ship systems regardless of [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]].<ref name="SotG" /> The [[Bank of the Core/Legends|Bank of the Core's]] [[GCC-1000]] was specifically designed to be resistant to radiation storms.<ref name="SotG" />
